5. STILL-PRESENT: `writeback.ts` still normalizes mixed line endings by choosing one newline style for the whole file after `split(/\r?\n/)` (`src/lib/readiness/writeback.ts.tmpl:65-67`, `97`).
6. STILL-PRESENT: tmp cleanup still swallows `unlinkSync` failure, so “no tmp left behind” is not enforced (`src/lib/readiness/writeback.ts.tmpl:106-112`).

**New Findings**
- [MEDIUM] `src/app/admin/readiness/page.tsx.tmpl:343-353`: `"in-sprint"` items render through `OpenItemRow`, which always posts a toggle form (`132-149`), but the action rejects every non-`owner-action` item (`actions.ts.tmpl:79-83`). Sprint-work/waiver rows therefore expose a control that is guaranteed to fail. Render a non-submit row for in-sprint items or only use `OpenItemRow` for owner-action rows.

- [MEDIUM] `src/lib/readiness/writeback.ts.tmpl:69-80`: duplicate checklist ids are not fail-closed. The code patches the first matching line and stops, despite the contract requiring “the single line” for `id=<id>`. Duplicate ids should return `{ ok:false }` with no write to avoid ambiguous source-of-truth mutation.
